author: DonAndres8
body:
I'd prioritize getting ornate cockatrice mail, Balor crown, Heimdall's shield, horror, and nothren boots in that order. Legendary will work if rng is no bueno.

You should be running boss gauntlets at this point which will help with aquiring those as well as other useful accessories. High def gear is going to be needed in t9 for apollyon and the cockmail will be good for him as well as for boss gauntlets as it provides immunity from petrify.

Also kill midnight gazers for the midnight eyes accessories to use for world gear. Maximizing view distance is OP.

My world gear was lost helmet, ankous robe, two ornate Ra's canes, nothren boots, and midnight eyes.

Gauntlet gear: Balor crown, cock mail, nothren shoes, horror, Heimdall's shield, and accessories to prevent debuffs to my attack and def.

Raid gear: Balor crown, cock mail/ankou/nothren robe (depending on if their attacks), nothren shoes, def debuff accessory, and either attack debuff accessory or accessory to prevent blight/curse.
